seoTitle: Sitemap URL XML Escaper (& and Encoding)
metaDescription: Make raw URLs safe for a sitemap: percent-encode spaces and non-ASCII, then escape & < > quotes. Free, runs locally.
intro: Escapes URLs so they are valid inside sitemap XML.
why:
A raw ampersand in a sitemap makes the XML invalid. So do spaces and some characters in URLs.

This tool percent-encodes unsafe characters and then applies the XML entity escapes from sitemaps.org (& ' " > <). By default it leaves existing entities alone so you do not get &amp;.
howTo: Paste raw URLs, one per line.
Choose whether to wrap them in loc tags.
Leave the other options as they are for most cases.

faq.a: XML needs it. The crawler reads it back as &.
Keep the entity option on to avoid it.

faq.q: Do I need this if I use a generator?
faq.a: Good generators do it already. This is for hand-made lists.
